transcript.text: Walk me through your experience and why a management programme makes sense for you now.

I've worked in retail banking for five years, the last four as a relationship manager at a private-sector bank in Mumbai. I manage a portfolio of about 180 customers and reached 112% of my annual target last year. I started in customer service, and I know how customers react when a product is mis-sold. I want an MBA to move from selling individual products to designing the products and the customer segments.

You mentioned managing a portfolio of about 180 customers and exceeding your target last year. Can you describe a specific challenge you faced with a customer or product mis-selling scenario, and how you handled it?
